data.body: RECURRENCE 2026-09-10 (same boot, Sep 6 11:25): fseventsd re-accreted to 107GB phys_footprint (27.2GB RSS + 79.8GB swapped, 136.8M live mallocs, 47.8M PathStringZone strings = 11.3GB) by day 4, swap 67/68.6GB used, host approaching second exhaustion crash. fsmonitor fix (AC1) held — zero fsmonitor daemons. This boot's stale-FSEvents-client class was the OPEN FOLLOW-UP flagged here: codex (ChatGPT.app, PID 11153) spawned one serena+pyright+node+headroom-mcp stack per conversation (Sep 6/7/9/10) and never reaped old ones; stale stacks ~1.2GB each, fully swapped out, streams open but undrained. Hypothesis test: killing one stale serena freed only its own swap; fseventsd stayed at 107GB (peak==current — it never returns accreted memory), so reclaim requires fseventsd restart (SIP blocks kickstart; sudo kill <pid> works, launchd respawns). Remediation today: stale Sep 6/7/9 stacks killed by pid; serena DISABLED for codex in ~/.codex/config.toml (enabled=false, annotated); fseventsd restart pending operator. Evidence: .rebar/scratch/memleak-copilot-87759/ (user-footprints, fseventsd-vmmap, growth samples). Follow-up bug being created + linked discovered_from.
